description: The long version: running a marathon as a college freshman, learning to fit running around work, Boston in 2017, moving to trail, a first 100 miler paced by my wife, and how The Speed Project keeps turning up at pivotal moments.

episode: Lucy Scholz on winning The Speed Project Solo and breaking the course record
description: Recorded a few weeks after the win. What it actually takes to run 293 miles from Los Angeles to Las Vegas, why I went in self-coached, and the crew of nine women who got me to Vegas.
On winning The Speed Project solo with an all-female crew, and why that sense of community matters so much in running.

episode: r.an a.cross the d.esert (9 hours faster than everyone else) - Lucy Scholz
description: The Speed Project Solo win, from the inside. 293 miles from Santa Monica to Las Vegas, finished faster than anyone else in the field.
Looking back on the 2025 run from Los Angeles to Las Vegas, running solo and as part of Team Solo.
